name: The Universe, Which Has Opinions
tagline: An active agent in this canon. It listens, it interferes, and it has a one-liner every time. FOUR women, not six.
body:
IT IS NOT WEATHER. It intervenes deliberately, in specific people's lives, and there is a transcript. FOUR WOMEN HAVE BEEN GIVEN A BODY BY IT, and the Archive had SIX on this page until Viraena counted them out loud.

TO ALICE, who took one honest minute to genuinely wonder what having a cock would be like: “BET.” She woke up with one, plus balls and a prostate, and her panties no longer fit.

TO IZZY AND FIONA, years into a rented hotel room and busking: “YOU'VE STRUGGLED ENOUGH. HERE.” They woke affirmed, both of them, on the same night, matched to the decimal.

TO MEGAN, twenty-seven years into a pussy, running a bar built around other women's pleasure and watching from a swivel chair: A COCK. She intends to make up for every one of those years.

AND THE DELIVERY ALWAYS MATCHES THE WOMAN. Alice asked a question, so it answered the question. The twins had nothing left to give, so it gave to both at once and made them identical. Megan had spent her whole life on the watching side, so IT DID NOT GIVE THE VOYEUR SOMETHING TO WATCH — IT GAVE HER SOMETHING TO BE ON THE RECEIVING END OF.

NONE OF THE FOUR WERE TOUCHED BY PROJECT NEREID.

WHO IS NOT ON THIS LIST, AND WAS. NOVA BENNET and JADE EVERREST both appeared here and neither belongs. Nova went through ST. JONAH'S; her body is not a universe gift. Jade HAS ALWAYS HAD A COCK — the push notification that became Pandora was a gift of a PERSON, not of anatomy, and filing it beside the Cockening blurred two completely different kinds of event. Both were the Archive's invention and both are withdrawn.
